resource: Live item handles of one GameSession (items in at least one of the session's views)
allocation_impact: Measured as the sum of the view bounds: 255 domain-1 objects (MOVE-RL-11 less the own player), 30 domain-9 items (ITEMV0-RL-01) and 16 domain-11 entries (ITEMV0-RL-02); the open corpse keeps its domain-1 handle. The handle table (ITEM-VIEW-1b) is bounded by this value before inserting; a handle leaving every view is dropped, and the table never grows past the views it serves.
boundary_tests: max=301: the views at their bounds hold 301 live handles
max+1=302: the table refuses a handle beyond the views' bounds
notes: ITEM-MOVE-WIRE-0 §4.1 and §4.4. The codec test binds the derivation; the table enforcing it is ITEM-VIEW-1b's. Registered by OTV2-20261003-item-view-1a.
